text: A well-posed body keeps the spine straight and stretched as tall as possible.
quote: The spine must always be straight and as tall as possible.

text: A spine stretched as long as possible makes a person look more confident.
quote: to make a person look more confident, we must stretch the spine to make it as long as possible

text: Long hours sitting at computers give people a habitual slouch when sitting and a hunch of the upper back when standing.
quote: Thanks to the hours we spend sitting improperly in front of our computers, we have developed a terrible habit of slouching when we sit and hunching when we stand.

text: A good single-person posture lifts the back of the head high above the collarbone, keeping the neck long and the chin level.
quote: I use the cervical spine to lift the back of the subject’s head as high as possible above the collarbone.

text: A deep breath in straightens the body and inflates the chest, giving a confident look.
quote: The reason for this is to get that confident, inflated look that breathing in provides.

text: Shoulders dropped and moved about two inches back expand the chest and make a person look confident and strong.
quote: Moving the shoulders two inches or so back is important to expand the chest.

text: Shoulders left forward rather than pulled back make a person look sluggish and disinterested.
quote: the shoulders are not being pushed back a couple of inches as described in technique 3. This is causing her to look sluggish and disinterested.

text: The lower back should always keep at least its natural inward curve, and is exaggerated a bit more for an attractive pose; a flat lower back looks bad.
quote: At a minimum, the lumbar should always be curved at its natural position.

text: A flat lower back flattens the whole body and removes its curves.
quote: that small part of the spine flattens the whole body, and it greatly reduces our ability to give the body curves

text: Standing against a wall, a good posture leaves a clear gap behind the lower back about the thickness of an arm, for both men and women.
quote: There should be a clear gap between the wall and the lower spine. This is true for men and women.

text: An elongated upper back gives posture that reads as confident and strong.
quote: Responsible for posture. It also should be elongated as much as possible. Creates confidence and strength.

text: A person lacking confidence shows a less tall upper back and a chest that is not inflated.
quote: If she were, her body would be more stretched and her chest would be more inflated.

text: Children often stand square and symmetrical facing the viewer, a stance that reads as innocent.
quote: Children often pose themselves in a very symmetrical way, giving this pose a possibly innocent energy.

text: Bone structure and a double chin under the jaw are noted as fixed features of a person's build.
quote: Another point to keep in mind is your subject’s bone structure and whether he or she has a double chin.
